en: Sepia-toned vintage view of a European city on a river. A multi-arch stone bridge crosses the water, with numerous moored riverboats below. On the left stands a tall baroque-style church tower; near the center is a grand neoclassical theater building; in the background is a high tower and several other domes and spires. The word "Dresden." is printed at the upper left of the image.
